Brine.luau.description: Fast and efficient extensible serialiation and deserialization library for Roblox with native instance support out of the box Public entry points include `Brine.serialize`, `Brine.deserialize`.

BrineTypes.luau.description: Brine Types provides the class/model implementation used by the Brine package.

Context/BrineContext.luau.description: Brine Context provides the class/model implementation used by the Brine package. Public entry points include `BrineContext.new`, `BrineContext.FindSerialization`, `BrineContext.FindDeserialization`, `BrineContext.StoreSerialization`, `BrineContext.ReplaceInstancesWithSerializedInstances`, `encode`, `BrineContext.ReplaceSerializedInstancesWithInstances`, `decode`.

Context/BrineOptionUtils.luau.description: Brine Option Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Brine package. Public entry points include `BrineOptionUtils.defaultOptions`.

DataTypes/BrineInstanceEncoder.luau.description: Brine Instance Encoder provides the class/model implementation used by the Brine package. Public entry points include `BrineInstanceEncoder.encodeProperties`, `BrineInstanceEncoder.encodeInstance`, `BrineInstanceEncoder.encodeAttributes`, `BrineInstanceEncoder.encodeTags`, `BrineInstanceEncoder.encodeChildren`, `BrineInstanceEncoder.decodeInstance`, `BrineInstanceEncoder.decodeAttributes`,…

DataTypes/BrineInstanceReflection.luau.description: Brine Instance Reflection provides the class/model implementation used by the Brine package. Public entry points include `BrineInstanceReflection.canConstruct`, `BrineInstanceReflection.getEncodedProperties`.
